headline: Three games now let you hide the pad
lede: Slot b took the warden's target — the PADTYPES rollout tail — and shipped the pointer taste calls: MINESWEEPER, GARDEN GUARD and HOMEBODY now offer a POINTER controller in the pause menu, dropping the pad chrome so the canvas itself takes orders. The d-pad stays the default; the choice persists per game.

notes.text: #3129 pointer grants merged (#3182): Minesweeper tap-digs and press-and-hold flags like the 1990 original, Garden Guard plants straight onto the lawn, Homebody orders the lot by tap — all with the pad gone.

padtypecheck 90→99 pins the grants, keeps the derived defaults, and pins each game's canvas tap verb at source — a POINTER grant without a real tap verb would be a dead pad, and now it can't ship. Mutant-proven red/green.

padtypeplay gained a live Minesweeper leg: switch to POINTER in the pause menu, a real touch digs a cell, a 650 ms hold plants a flag. Along the way it caught that the shell has multiple canvases — the HUD strip is not the board.
#3129 stays open for its tilt tail: tilt beyond MARBLE MADNESS waits on #3107 merging plus a real-iPhone ENABLE TILT check — Chrome can only prove the synthetic path.
